# Pydantic schemas for Asana API
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any

class TaskParams(BaseModel):
    task_gid: str = Field(..., description="The task to operate on.")
    data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(..., description="Data related to task operations.")

class SectionParams(BaseModel):
    section_gid: str = Field(..., description="The section to operate on.")
    data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(..., description="Data related to section operations.")

class TaskListResponse(BaseModel):
    data: Optional[Any]

class ApiResponse(BaseModel):
    data: Optional[Any]
    success: bool

# Integration tests for Asana API
import pytest
from fastapi import FastAPI
from httpx import AsyncClient
from .route import router as asana_router

app = FastAPI()
app.include_router(asana_router)

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_add_task_for_section():
    async with AsyncClient(app=app, base_url="http://test") as ac:
        response = await ac.post("/asana/addTaskForSection", json={
            "section_gid": "section123",
            "data": {"task": "task123"}
        })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["success"]

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_remove_follower_for_task():
    async with AsyncClient(app=app, base_url="http://test") as ac:
        response = await ac.post("/asana/removeFollowerForTask", json={
            "task_gid": "task123",
            "user_gid": "user123"
        })
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["success"]
